value.author: Sunil
value.title: An overall a very good property with your needs completed.
value.text:
I have booked this hotel for a short stay last month. The ambience was nice and calm. What I liked was the response from the front desk staff. He was polite and courteous. The check-in process was smooth and quick. The rooms were spacious. The room service was prompt. The bathroom was neat and clean and provided with toiletries. You can check with the hotel prior to booking. I had used book and pay later for booking this hotel. There is a restaurant in this property. The food was good. No issues. It's overall a good property.

value.author: Ronak
value.title: Upgradtion moment for me.
value.text:
The Stay Of The Hotel Was Lovely Like To Visit Here Again This was my second stay at ELVIS Hotel. There hotel has upgraded and the rooms are in very good condition. The rooms are well maintained and the bed comfortable. All the facilities exceeded my expectation. The food at the restaurant was very good and delicious. The WIFI at the hotel is very good with no problems at all. The staff are very service orientated and go out of their way to assist in all areas. They assisted with booking of taxis and gave good advise to their guests.
— No nothing a pinch.
